Questions

What is the median annual wage for Software developers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Software Developers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $134,120.

What is the hourly median for Software developers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Software Developers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $64.48.

How many Software developers work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 31,960 wage-and-salary Software Developers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Software developers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 2.28. Values above 1.00 mean Software Developers are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Software developers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Software Developers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $143,630.

How does Austin's Software developers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($134,120) is $260 lower than Chicago ($134,380) and $33,160 lower than Seattle ($167,280). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
